mapper.sql: COALESCE( NULLIF(r.quality_dimension, ''), CASE re.rule_type WHEN 'TABLE_ROW_COUNT' THEN '完整性' WHEN 'COLUMN_NOT_NULL' THEN '完整性' WHEN 'COLUMN_UNIQUE' THEN '唯一性' WHEN 'COLUMN_RANGE' THEN '有效性' WHEN 'COLUMN_ENUM' THEN '准确性' WHEN 'CUSTOM_SQL' THEN '自定义' ELSE '其他' END)
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT( m.data_source_id, '|', COALESCE(m.database_name, ''), '|', COALESCE(m.schema_name, ''), '|', m.table_name)) FROM yak_quality_monitor m WHERE m.deleted = 0 AND m.enabled = 1) AS monitored_table_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yak_quality_rule r INNER JOIN yak_quality_monitor m ON m.id = r.monitor_id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.enabled = 1 AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.enabled = 1) AS enabled_rule_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yak_quality_execution e WHERE e.queued_at >= #{todayStart} AND e.queued_at < #{todayEnd}) AS today_execution_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.monitor_id) FROM yak_quality_execution e WHERE e.queued_at >= #{todayStart} AND e.queued_at < #{todayEnd} AND e.check_result IN ('NOT_PASSED', 'ERROR')) AS today_issue_table_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yak_quality_rule_execution re INNER JOIN yak_quality_execution e ON e.id = re.execution_id WHERE e.queued_at >= #{rangeStart} AND e.queued_at < #{rangeEnd} AND re.check_result IN ('PASSED', 'NOT_PASSED', 'ERROR')) AS recent_executed_rule_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yak_quality_rule_execution re INNER JOIN yak_quality_execution e ON e.id = re.execution_id WHERE e.queued_at >= #{rangeStart} AND e.queued_at < #{rangeEnd} AND re.check_result = 'PASSED') AS recent_passed_rule_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM yak_quality_rule_execution re INNER JOIN yak_quality_execution e ON e.id = re.execution_id WHERE e.queued_at >= #{rangeStart} AND e.queued_at < #{rangeEnd} AND re.check_result IN ('NOT_PASSED', 'ERROR')) AS recent_issue_rule_count

SELECT execution_stats.execution_count, execution_stats.active_monitor_count, rule_stats.executed_rule_count, rule_stats.passed_rule_count, rule_stats.failed_rule_count, rule_stats.error_rule_count, execution_stats.issue_execution_count, rule_stats.affected_monitor_count, rule_stats.affected_table_count, rule_stats.affected_column_count, execution_stats.average_duration_ms, execution_stats.latest_execution_at FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.monitor_id) AS active_monitor_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.check_result IN ('NOT_PASSED', 'ERROR') OR e.failed_rules > 0 OR e.error_rules > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issue_execution_count, AVG(e.duration_ms) AS average_duration_ms, MAX(e.queued_at) AS latest_execution_at FROM yak_quality_execution e WHERE e.queued_at >= #{rangeStart} AND e.queued_at < #{rangeEnd} ) execution_stats CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS executed_rule_count, SUM(CASE WHEN re.check_result = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_rule_count, SUM(CASE WHEN re.check_result = 'NOT_PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_rule_count, SUM(CASE WHEN re.check_result = 'ERROR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error_rule_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN re.check_result IN ('NOT_PASSED', 'ERROR') THEN e.monitor_id END) AS affected_monitor_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN re.check_result IN ('NOT_PASSED', 'ERROR') THEN CONCAT( e.data_source_id, '|', COALESCE(e.database_name, ''), '|', COALESCE(e.schema_name, ''), '|', e.table_name) END) AS affected_table_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN re.check_result IN ('NOT_PASSED', 'ERROR') AND re.column_name IS NOT NULL AND re.column_name <> '' THEN CONCAT( e.data_source_id, '|', COALESCE(e.database_name, ''), '|', COALESCE(e.schema_name, ''), '|', e.table_name, '|', re.column_name) END) AS affected_column_count FROM yak_quality_rule_execution re INNER JOIN yak_quality_execution e ON e.id = re.execution_id WHERE e.queued_at >= #{rangeStart} AND e.queued_at < #{rangeEnd} AND re.check_result IN ('PASSED', 'NOT_PASSED', 'ERROR') ) rule_stats

SELECT AS dimension, COUNT(*) AS total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN re.check_result = 'PASSED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_count, SUM(CASE WHEN re.check_result IN ('NOT_PASSED', 'ERROR') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issue_count FROM yak_quality_rule_execution re INNER JOIN yak_quality_execution e ON e.id = re.execution_id LEFT JOIN yak_quality_rule r ON r.id = re.rule_id WHERE e.queued_at >= #{rangeStart} AND e.queued_at < #{rangeEnd} AND re.check_result IN ('PASSED', 'NOT_PASSED', 'ERROR') GROUP BY ORDER BY CASE WHEN '完整性' THEN 1 WHEN '准确性' THEN 2 WHEN '唯一性' THEN 3 WHEN '有效性' THEN 4 WHEN '一致性' THEN 5 WHEN '时效性' THEN 6 WHEN '自定义' THEN 7 ELSE 99 END,

SELECT DATE(e.queued_at) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS execution_count, COUNT(DISTINCT e.monitor_id) AS active_monitor_count, SUM(e.passed_rules + e.failed_rules + e.error_rules) AS executed_rule_count, SUM(e.passed_rules) AS passed_rule_count, SUM(e.failed_rules) AS failed_rule_count, SUM(e.error_rules) AS error_rule_count, SUM(CASE WHEN e.check_result IN ('NOT_PASSED', 'ERROR') OR e.failed_rules > 0 OR e.error_rules > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS issue_execution_count, AVG(e.duration_ms) AS average_duration_ms FROM yak_quality_execution e WHERE e.queued_at >= #{rangeStart} AND e.queued_at < #{rangeEnd} GROUP BY DATE(e.queued_at) ORDER BY stat_date ASC

SELECT re.id AS rule_execution_id, e.execution_no, e.monitor_id, e.monitor_name, e.object_name, e.table_name, re.rule_name, AS dimension, re.column_name, re.check_result, e.queued_at FROM yak_quality_rule_execution re INNER JOIN yak_quality_execution e ON e.id = re.execution_id LEFT JOIN yak_quality_rule r ON r.id = re.rule_id WHERE e.queued_at >= #{rangeStart} AND e.queued_at < #{rangeEnd} AND re.check_result IN ('NOT_PASSED', 'ERROR') ORDER BY e.queued_at DESC, e.id DESC, re.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
